limits: Finite fixtures and mutation campaigns do not establish universal compatibility or memory safety.
CSRI BGRX rendering and format queries; real Aegisub/player and other host integration remains outstanding.
Comparisons pair reference and candidate on the same architecture and environment, not across architectures.
Most native parsing, font handling, rasterization, compositing and third-party code remains C++.
Drawing preprocessing, numeric conversion, scaling and final path storage remain native.
Native sanitizers cover extracted C++ tests, not the full renderer or Rust static library.
Native out-of-memory recovery, Windows 7 and older CPUs remain unverified.
WebVTT end-of-list insertion has candidate-only validation and is excluded from reference-parity counts.

bitmap_scope.boundary: Rust owns run-decoding state. Native code performs each requested bit/byte/EOF operation, palette lookup, rectangle draw, coordinate/dirty-rectangle update and DVB byte alignment.
bitmap_scope.windows_rectangle_api: Real User32 UnionRect on both Windows architectures; portable stand-in on other hosts.
bitmap_scope.native_pixels: Pinned original packed and planar SSE pixel-fill methods on x86/x64. Pixel comparisons include injected partial operations, padding and guards. Separate non-injected fixtures must visibly draw.
bitmap_scope.trace_only_inputs: Extreme and malformed coordinate cases compare requested operations and state without passing out-of-surface rectangles to the native pixel fillers.
retained_native_scope: HDMV/DVB packet parsing and host playback
bitmap_scope.csri_scope: The full DLL corpus verifies text-renderer regressions; it does not establish HDMV/DVB packet or host integration.
